name: voice-agent
description: Talk with Claude out loud, fully local: Parakeet hears you, Phonon speaks, and agreed tasks go to background agents while you keep talking.

autoStart.title: Start voice with each session
autoStart.description: Turn voice on as soon as a session starts, instead of with /talk on.

mode.title: Listening mode
mode.description: wake: say the wake word first. natural: the mic is always open. ptt: only while the push-to-talk key is held. Push-to-talk works in every mode.

wakeWord.title: Wake word
wakeWord.description: The phrase that starts a request in wake mode.

sttModel.title: Speech recognition model
sttModel.description: NVIDIA Parakeet model. parakeet-v2 is English; parakeet-v3 covers 25 European languages.

sttDevice.title: Speech recognition device
sttDevice.description: auto uses an NVIDIA GPU when there is one (the first start downloads the CUDA runtime, about 2 GB, and the full model, about 2.4 GB), else the CPU.

turnDetection.title: Smart end-of-turn detection
turnDetection.description: A small audio model (Smart Turn v3, 9 MB) tells when you have finished: Claude answers as soon as you sound done and waits through pauses mid-sentence. Off: a fixed pause ends what you say (see Pause that ends your turn).

vadStrictness.title: Voice detection strictness
vadStrictness.description: 0 to 3. Higher ignores more background noise but may miss very quiet speech.

minSpeechMs.title: Minimum speech length (ms)
minSpeechMs.description: Sounds shorter than this are ignored.

loudnessRatio.title: Minimum loudness over background
loudnessRatio.description: How many times louder than the background noise speech must be. Higher ignores more background voices; 0 turns it off.

pauseMs.title: Pause that ends your turn (ms)
pauseMs.description: How long a silence means you've finished talking. Longer lets you pause mid-sentence; shorter replies sooner. Used when turn detection is off.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for recognition and speech: en, fr, de, es or pt. Other than en needs a multilingual voice model and a non-.en recognition model.

ttsModel.title: Phonon voice model
ttsModel.description: Empty uses Phonon 31m (English, Apache 2.0). For example hf://gradium/phonon-40m-en (non-commercial, gated: accept its terms on Hugging Face and run hf auth login).

ttsVoice.title: Voice
ttsVoice.description: A Phonon voice name (list them with: uvx ptts --list-voices). Empty uses the model's default.

bargeIn.title: Interrupt by talking
bargeIn.description: Talking while Claude speaks stops it. In natural mode this works best with headphones or PipeWire echo cancellation.

followUpSeconds.title: Follow-up window (seconds)
followUpSeconds.description: In wake mode, how long after Claude speaks you can answer without the wake word.

chimes.title: Chimes
chimes.description: Short sounds when the wake word is heard, push-to-talk starts and ends, and a question is asked.

voicePermissions.title: Answer permission prompts by voice
voicePermissions.description: When Claude or an agent needs permission, ask out loud and take a spoken yes or no. No answer falls back to the usual prompt.

askTimeoutSeconds.title: Spoken question timeout (seconds)
askTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a spoken yes or no before falling back to the usual permission prompt.

partnerModel.title: Model for the conversation
partnerModel.description: Model alias or id for the main, talking Claude while voice is on (a faster model feels more natural). Empty uses the session's model.

partnerEffort.title: Thinking effort for the conversation
partnerEffort.description: Lower effort answers faster. default uses the session's setting.

agentModel.title: Model for background agents
agentModel.description: Empty lets the agent type decide.

agentType.title: Agent type for tasks
agentType.description: The subagent type tasks are handed to. Empty uses general-purpose.

helperCommand.title: Voice helper command
helperCommand.description: Advanced: how to start the voice helper instead of uv run --script, e.g. ~/.venvs/voice/bin/python /path/to/voice_helper.py
